votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of May 4, 2021; May 18, 2021; June 8, 2021; January 18, 2022; and February 8, 2022.
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from five previous RDA Board meetings spanning May 2021 through February 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 2 of 2022: Housing Development Loan Program (HDLP) Amendment.
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution amending the Housing Development Loan Program policy to add standards for distributing Emergency Gap Financing Funds and charge the RDA Finance Committee with reviewing applications for this funding.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (setting the date of Tuesday, April 12, 2022 at 2 p.m. for public comment and consideration of RDA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2021-22).
votes.description: The Board approved the consent agenda, which set a public hearing date of April 12, 2022 to consider adopting a resolution amending the RDA's FY 2021-22 budget, covering items such as Ballpark development funding, an ADU pilot program, and transfer of the Housing Trust Fund to the RDA.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and attorney-client matters that are privileged.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and privileged attorney-client matters.

votes.motion: Exit Closed Session and adjourn as the RDA.
votes.description: The Board voted to end the closed session and adjourn the RDA meeting.
